note: Regional park in the South Saskatchewan River valley at the west edge of Outlook, beside the Riverview Golf Club and the Trans Canada Trail. A row of five sites (66-70) looks across open grass and a line of trees to the river. A few sites are sold by the season. --Claude
summary: Keep. Operator page + Let's Camp (live, 69 units listed) + SRPA 2026 guide. 62 bookable RV sites 15/30 A + water ($35), no sewer on any nightly site (sewer true -> false), max 44 ft, one pull-through; vehicle pass $8/day; season May long weekend-Sep 30 (stored May 1-Oct 31 corrected). Nightly share ~89%. Waterfront not waterfront -> riverview (sites 66-70). Pin OK.
flags: WATERFRONT: not waterfront -> riverview (stored value not --AWH). Let's Camp's 2026 park map names a 'Riverview' row, sites 66-70, on the river side of the park; their photos (66-70) show open grass, then a line of deciduous trees with the South Saskatchewan River visible through the gaps (clearest at 69 and 68). Esri z17: an open area west of the park road at ~51.4848,-107.0693 sits ~50-60 m from the river's vegetated bank behind a ~40 m band of trees - a view, not riverfront. Sites 66-70 are sold by the night on Let's Camp ($35, 15/30 A + water). Loop position on imagery is matched from the map, not GIS points.

HOOKUPS: sewer true -> false: every site Let's Camp sells by the night lists sewer false; the only sewer ('septic, water, 50 amp') is the new seasonal site type. Electric 30 confirmed (15/30 A); 50 A only on seasonal sites.

SITES: count 80 (old note) -> 66 (62 RV sites + 4 small 15-amp sites, all sold online by the night; plus 3 cabins). max_rig_ft 44 added (Let's Camp maxRvLength). Sites 81-84 cap RVs at 18 ft. The map's 8 'Pancake' sites are not sold online (likely the seasonal ones).

NIGHTLY SHARE: 66 of ~74 camping sites on the map are sold by the night online (~89%); 'New!! Seasonal Campsites Available!' on the operator page. Not mostly seasonal; the note mentions the seasonal sites.
SEASON: 05-01..10-31 -> 05-15..09-30 from the SRPA 2026 guide ('May long weekend to Sept 30'); the operator page posts no season. 2027 not out.
FEES: daily $35 and vehicle pass $8/day confirmed; reservation_fee 10 and entrance {8,8,vehicle_day} added; monthly $900, cabins $50.
BOOKING: platform unset -> operator, url https://www.letscamp.ca/camps/outlook-regional-park (staged January openings, longest stays first).
FACILITIES: camp_store true (old note 'general store') - Let's Camp lists only a 'concession'; left alone, unconfirmed.

PIN: stored 51.48487,-107.06728 is on the park road at the north junction; the RV loops lie 50-300 m S and SE, Riverview ~140 m W. OK (Let's Camp point 51.485859,-107.067057 is ~110 m N, near the entrance).
PHONE 306-867-8846 and website confirmed. Website could add the Let's Camp link.
